gaps.summary: Production OpenTelemetry SDK/OTLP exporter and Collector deployment are not composed. Trace and metric records currently use vendor-neutral contracts; the API default sink only emits safe JSON logs.
Canonical EventEnvelope producer propagation and message child-context helper exist, but production queue consumers/workers have not all been wired to continue request/correlation/trace context.
Graph/AgentRun/Task/Tool/ModelGateway/provider/worker/database spans and business reference binding are not comprehensively instrumented end-to-end.
Fail-open LangSmith port is implemented, but a production LangSmith/OTel adapter, Agent/LLM trace fan-out and eval integration are not composed or executed.
HTTP duration metric core exists, but Agent/provider/queue/worker/database/cache/cost/quality/security/realtime metric producers are not all bound to production telemetry.
Vendor-neutral dashboard specification exists, but dashboard backend/data sources, queries and deployed render verification are absent.
Alert policy inventory exists, but alert engine/routing, on-call ownership, runbooks, deduplication and fire/drill evidence are not deployed and tested.
API completion logs use the safe JSON contract, but all services/workers/providers/admin paths have not migrated to structured correlation-aware logging with production redaction verification.
Frontend Web Vitals, safe browser error reporting and backend correlation handoff are not implemented/deployed.
External health/project-create/Agent-command/Artifact/Export synthetic checks and alert integration are not deployed.
Versioned SLO/error-budget math and policy exist, but production measurements, exclusion rules, burn-rate windows, reporting and release/use decisions have not been verified against real traffic.
Production telemetry retention/privacy/access control, Collector backpressure/HA, cardinality budgets, sampling cost and exporter-drop monitoring require deployment evidence.
Latest-head NODE-67 CI and production-like HTTP→queue→worker/exporter validation must actually execute green; skipped/pre-run jobs are not PASS.
RequestIdMiddleware now owns bounded X-Request-ID/X-Correlation-ID plus W3C traceparent/tracestate continuation and response propagation.
Authenticated RequestContext now receives middleware-generated request_id and actual trace_id rather than raw client headers, and organization_id is bound into telemetry context.
Canonical EventEnvelope additively carries request_id/correlation_id/traceparent/tracestate and new_event inherits the active telemetry context; existing Outbox serialization preserves the fields.
Message consumer helper creates a child span context from canonical EventEnvelope correlation fields without inventing a second queue envelope.
SafeTelemetry and SafeLangSmithTracer swallow exporter/vendor failures so observability cannot become a business availability dependency.
Structured log/span attribute validation rejects prompt/content/credential/secret fields; metric labels use a fixed low-cardinality allowlist and reject organization/run identifiers.
Deterministic normal-trace sampling is implemented while ERROR/CRITICAL/forced evidence is never sampled away.
The API app composes a safe standard-library structured JSON logging sink immediately while trace/metric exporter deployment remains explicit.
Versioned SLO/error-budget model plus dashboard, alert and sampling policy artifacts are implemented without claiming production measurement/deployment.
An outer final response-header enforcement layer preserves NODE-66 CSP/nosniff/frame/referrer/HSTS policy for correlation/idempotency short-circuit responses without changing input security gates.
